start_roi.comment: Coordinates are normalized (0-1). x1,y1 = top-left, x2,y2 = bottom-right

end_roi.comment: Coordinates are normalized (0-1). x1,y1 = top-left, x2,y2 = bottom-right

exposure.comment: mode: 'auto' or 'manual'. time_us: exposure time in microseconds, iso: 100-1600, compensation: -3 to +3

motion_detection.comment: threshold: sensitivity (lower = more sensitive), min_contour_area: minimum size in pixels

capture.comment: cooldown prevents multiple captures of the same motion event
